en-US.heroPrimary: IN4MATX 133 is UCI's User Interface Software course, focused on building interfaces with web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern UI frameworks.
en-US.heroSecondary: This page collects lecture-by-lecture notes with live, editable HTML/CSS/JS demos, for classmates who want a structured review of markup and accessibility, styling and responsive layout, the DOM, and UI tooling.
en-US.readerDescription: This page presents {course}{weekPhrase} notes in a structured reading format so you can review HTML, CSS, JavaScript, the DOM, and UI tooling lecture by lecture, with live demos you can edit and run. The path below takes you back to Notes, Course Notes, the course page, or this note file. Hover over the ≡ icon on the right side to open the Table of Contents.
